subject: spanish
title: Ser and Estar Foundations
welcome_lead: Master the two Spanish verbs for 'to be': ser and estar.
meta_desc: GCSE Spanish foundations adventure on ser and estar.
final_note: ¡Bien hecho! You now know when to use ser vs estar.

concepts.def: I am (estar) — for location and feelings.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use ser for permanent things: identity, profession, nationality, time, descriptions. Forms: soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son. Examples: Soy inglés (I'm English), Es profesora (She's a teacher), Son las tres (It's 3 o'clock).

Use estar for location and temporary states (feelings, conditions). Forms: estoy, estás, está, estamos, estáis, están. Examples: Estoy en casa (I'm at home), Estás cansado (You're tired), Está enferma (She's ill).

Memory trick: ESTAR = PLACE (Position, Location, Action, Condition, Emotion). SER = DOCTOR (Description, Occupation, Characteristic, Time, Origin, Relationship). Madrid está en España (location). Madrid es la capital (characteristic).

numericals.q: How many present-tense forms does the verb 'ser' have (yo, tú, él, nosotros, vosotros, ellos)?

free_texts.q: Write the 'yo' form of ser (no accents).
